prompts.title: Parents' Opinion
prompts.question: What do your parents (or guardians) think about you?
prompts.guidance: Write what your parents genuinely observe about your responsibility, habits, reliability at home, and areas where they advise you to improve.

prompts.title: Teachers' / Employers' Opinion
prompts.question: What do your teachers, professors, or employers think about you?
prompts.guidance: Describe how your mentors or supervisors view your punctuality, sincerity, grasp of tasks, teamwork, and areas where they expect more from you.

prompts.title: Friends' & Colleagues' Opinion
prompts.question: What do your friends and colleagues think about you?
prompts.guidance: Mention how your peers see your cooperation, trustworthiness, sense of humour, availability in need, and any habits they tease or correct you about.

prompts.title: Your Own Opinion About Yourself
prompts.question: What is your own opinion about yourself?
prompts.guidance: State your genuine strengths, values, practical approach to challenges, and honest self-awareness of your current limitations.

prompts.title: Qualities You Would Like to Develop
prompts.question: What kind of person do you want to become / what qualities would you like to develop?
prompts.guidance: Outline concrete, actionable qualities and skills you are actively working to build for your personal growth and career.
